# TJS Design — Custom Websites for Local Service Businesses

## What is TJS Design?
TJS Design is a custom web design service run by Trevor Spencer, a web designer and digital marketing expert based in Salt Lake City, Utah. TJS Design builds fully custom, mobile-responsive, SEO-optimized websites exclusively for local service businesses — from plumbers and roofers to electricians, landscapers, handymen, auto repair shops, and cleaning services. Trevor has 12+ years of experience in product management, digital marketing, and sales at companies including Red Hat, Podium, Pluralsight, and Domo.

## What makes TJS Design different?
- Every website is built 100% from scratch — no templates, no drag-and-drop builders, no off-the-shelf layouts
- One expert handles everything start to finish — design, development, SEO, AEO, analytics, and launch
- Simple plans from $0 down on a 12-month agreement — same website and service on every plan
- Hosting, management and a weekly Google Business Profile post (52 a year) included
- Delivered in under 14 business days from the intake call
- Includes full on-page SEO, structured data (JSON-LD), AEO optimization, Google Search Console indexing, Bing Webmaster Tools, and Google Analytics 4 setup — all included

## Plans (12-month agreement, card on file)
Every plan includes the same year-one service: a fully custom, mobile-ready, SEO + AEO optimized website delivered in under 14 business days; Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4 setup; connection to the client's Google Business Profile; hosting, security, updates and uptime monitoring; content changes; up to one 30-minute call per month; support by phone, text and email; and a branded Google Business Profile post every week (52 per year).

- Own It — $999.99 upfront + $29.99/month for 12 months (due today $1,029.98; year one $1,359.87). Lowest total cost.
- Balanced — $499.99 upfront + $79.99/month for 12 months (due today $579.98; year one $1,459.87).
- Zero Down — $0 upfront + $129.99/month for 12 months (due today $129.99; year one $1,559.88).

If a client cancels during the first 12 months, the remaining year-one payments are still due. The website belongs to the client once year one is paid.

## After year one
Plans move automatically to Essential Care month-to-month on the card on file.
- Essential Care — $29.99/month month-to-month, or $19.99/month on a 12-month plan. Hosting, security and uptime; 52 weekly Google Business Profile posts; up to 3 small edits per month; text and email support during business hours.
- Premium Care — $79.99/month month-to-month, or $59.99/month on a 12-month plan. Everything in Essential plus up to one 30-minute call per month, bigger content changes and 24/7 support.
Month-to-month plans can be canceled anytime before the next charge by text, call or email.

## How It Works (4 steps)
1. Purchase & Schedule — Pay online and immediately book your 30-minute intake call during checkout
2. Intake Call — 30-minute session covering your services, brand, customers, and goals
3. Design Reviews — Receive 1–3 design previews; request changes until you approve
4. Launch — Site goes live, indexed in Google and Bing, analytics connected, fully operational

Click any "Get My Website" button on tjsdesign.online to open secure Stripe checkout on that page, choose a plan, agree to the 12-month terms, pay what is due today, and book the 30-minute intake call in the same flow. Questions first? Call or text (385) 472-3690.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does a website from TJS Design cost?
A: Three plans on a 12-month agreement: Own It ($999.99 upfront + $29.99/month), Balanced ($499.99 upfront + $79.99/month) or Zero Down ($0 upfront + $129.99/month). Each includes the custom website, hosting, management and 52 weekly Google Business Profile posts. After year one, Essential Care is $29.99/month month-to-month or $19.99/month on a 12-month plan.

Q: How long does it take?
A: Under 14 business days from the intake call, guaranteed.

Q: What do I need to provide?
A: Very little. The intake call covers everything — your services, branding, photos, and goals. No logo? That's fine too.

Q: Does TJS Design do SEO?
A: Yes. Every website includes full on-page SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), structured data (JSON-LD), Google Search Console setup, Bing Webmaster Tools, and GA4 — all included in every plan.

Q: What is AEO?
A: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) structures your site so AI-powered tools like Google's AI Overview, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can surface your business in answers. It works alongside traditional SEO.

Q: Is hosting included?
A: Yes. Hosting, security and uptime monitoring are part of every plan — there's no separate hosting bill. The only other cost is the domain ($10–$25/year), which the client owns outright.

Q: Is the 14-day timeline guaranteed?
A: Yes, on TJS Design's end. The timeline starts from your intake call and is met every time as long as design feedback is provided within a reasonable window.

Q: What happens after the first year?
A: The plan moves to Essential Care at $29.99/month month-to-month (cancel anytime before the next charge by text, call or email), or $19.99/month on another 12-month plan. Premium Care is $79.99/month ($59.99/month on a 12-month plan).

Q: Can I cancel in the first year?
A: Every plan is a 12-month agreement. Service can stop anytime, but the remaining year-one payments are still due. The site is the client's once year one is paid.

## Sourced Facts
- 56% of customer actions on Google Business Profiles were website clicks (BrightLocal study of 45,000+ listings, data Sept 2017–Dec 2018).
- 54% of consumers visit a business's website after reading positive reviews (BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey, 2026).
- 42% of citations in AI local search results (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews) came from business websites (BrightLocal Local AI Visibility Study, 2026).
- 47% of Google's top 10 organic results for local searches are business websites (BrightLocal Business Listings Visibility Study, 2024).
- 71% of consumers use Google Search when looking for a local business (BrightLocal Consumer Search Behavior Study, 2026).

## About Trevor Spencer
Trevor Spencer is the founder and sole operator of TJS Design. He has 12+ years of experience in digital marketing, product management, and sales at enterprise software companies. He founded TJS Design to give local service businesses access to professional, high-performance websites that actually generate leads — at a price point that makes sense for small businesses.
